summary: xAI announced that Grok 4.6, its flagship model with a 500k-token context window and configurable reasoning effort, is now generally available to developers through Amazon Bedrock at stated per-token pricing.

mechanisms.reason: Distribution through a major hyperscale cloud platform expands the addressable surface for inference calls to the model.
mechanisms.quote: Grok 4.6 is now available to all developers in supported AWS Regions.

mechanisms.reason: The model is stated to offer a 500k-token context window, which raises per-request memory content, though this restates an existing model property rather than a new increase.
mechanisms.quote: It offers 500k context window and configurable reasoning efforts (low, medium, high, xhigh).

categories.reason: The announcement's substance is the model being made available through Amazon Bedrock, a hyperscale cloud platform.
categories.quote: we’re excited to announce that Grok 4.6 is now generally available on Amazon Bedrock.

practices.reason: Teams building on AWS now have a new supported route to Grok 4.6 with stated pricing, which is schedulable integration work rather than a mere possibility.
practices.quote: Grok 4.6 is now available to all developers in supported AWS Regions.
